name: EyePointing
summary: Gaze selects the target and a finger-pointing gesture confirms it, combining the speed of the eyes with an explicit hand trigger.
howItWorks: The user looks at the target and points at it with the finger; the system uses gaze for the target and the pointing gesture as the confirmation.
